Pathway to Happiness

   pathwaytohappiness.com/courses/self-mastery-course-free/introduction

                                                                                       August 17, 2019




Introduction

We’re moving all courses to the new Self Mastery Community




Watch Video At: https://youtu.be/EHqYPgYAGH8

Some things to keep in mind.

Many people find the Gratitude exercise to be kind of uninteresting after a while. Maybe
even call it boring. You only have to survive it for a week before access to the next
exercise will show up. Really? Your mind could complain about feeling gratitude? Yes.
It will complain about stuff like that. It has weird thoughts sometimes. We will be
working on those but we can’t get to everything at once.

The lessons are time gated. This might seem a bit slow to begin with, but there is value
you will realize over time. When you get a few of these lessons going together you will
realize that you want time to practice and to get things integrated.

The Abdication of Power Session takes a completely different approach to change. It
uses a different part of your mind and will engage you in a different way. Part of your
mind likes variety and we will take advantage of that with different practices.

 If you walk into the gym on day one and say, “I’m going to bench press 300 lbs,” you
are setting yourself up for failure. To really get in shape you start with smaller weights
and do a lot of repetitions over a longer period of time.

Before you will be good at changing big beliefs and emotional reactions you will learn to
change many small beliefs and small emotional reactions.

I’d rather set you up for success so you have a completely different mind in 6 months to
a year. That is more important than trying to get somewhere by tomorrow.





                                                                                                                                   1/5

If you feel that your mind and your emotions are important to your life, then you will
feel the time of 6 months or a year invested is worth it. If you put years into your school
education, you can put a few months into your emotional well being.

Often times people wonder if this is all there is to it. Just this one exercise for the week?
No. Keep practicing this exercise very solidly even after you get the next session. Then
you will want to periodically come back to it. These simple little steps may not seem like
they are making big changes, or at least that might be what the critical voice in your
head says. But that critical voice doesn’t know how real change happens. If it did you
wouldn’t be looking elsewhere.

One of the reasons that we are seeking more information and assignments is that we
have a strong desire for change. This is a healthy desire in the way that it benefits us.
The downside can be that we become impulsive, in a hurry, and don’t take the most
efficient path. That part of our mind that is in a hurry is also placing expectations and
demands about how fast the change should happen. These can be unrealistic
expectations and set us up for failing to meet them, and self judgment that follows. This
is very demotivating and needs to be avoided.

I’m going to repeatedly help you to question your expectations about what it takes to
change unconscious beliefs you haven’t even found yet.

Resistance to change

There will be resistance. You are building new neural pathways You will have to do the
same habit for about 40 days, or repeat the same thing dozens of times to overcome the
automatic patterns of the mind learned in the past. This is normal and needs to be part
of your understanding and expectations.

Faster change is possible, but it requires a great deal of emotions to re-wire the brain in
a short time. Generating that much emotion, and in the right way can be difficult as
most people have their personal power invested in existing beliefs so they have little left
to build new neural pathways. This is why many of the practices focus on recovering
that personal power. As you recover personal power you will be able to make changes
faster.

One step at a time. The power you recover will allow you to move faster. in this way the
speed of your change will accelerate. By the time some people get to lesson 8 or 9 they
are kind of wishing for the process to slow down as the changes are going kind of fast
for them. For others, they are eager to the next lesson when it shows up.

Setting intent

Make out a list of goals that you want to accomplish. You might not see right away how
each lesson will get you to your goal. However, does the lesson help you gain a skill over
your Attention, Perspective, Emotions, or Personal Power?

                                                                                                                                   2/5

If you see each small step as helping you achieve your larger goal you will be able to
focus better. It will dispel the sabotaging stories of each practice.

If it is doing that then it is helping you gain the mastery to make the internal changes
you want to make. This should help motivate you to practice.

Practice time an focus

One of the ways to be successful in making changes is regular practice. One way to
prime yourself for success is to schedule the practice into tomorrow’s schedule. Know
when each day you are going to do each exercise.

This way it isn’t 10 pm and you are headed to bed when you realize that you didn’t do
any self mastery time. You already know when you will be doing it tomorrow.

You regularly get your meals in and your teeth brushed. That’s because you know when
those things are going to happen. Give the same chance for success for your own self
mastery.

Common questions

How often do I get a new lesson?
You have access to session 1 on Gratitude immediatley after signup.

You will get access to session 2 on Abdication of power in one week. You will get an
email when you have access to a new lesson.

You will also usually get an email between sessions to remind you of the practice, and
perhaps some nuances to focus on for more depth.

Why can't I get all the lessons at once?
We do our deep learning through repetition. For the benefits of the gratitude practice
to go deep they need to go into your neural pathways and strengthen them. It is like you
are building new muscles.

The repetition and simplicity for now will have far more impact over time than having a
lot of complex information.

I want results, how should I approach the lessons?
Schedule a certain time in your schedule for each practice. For instance, know when you
will do the gratitude practice tomorrow. If you make it the same time each day, then
that part is easy and you don’t have to figure out a new schedule each day.

Taking that one decision out of your day makes it simpler and more likely that you will
practice.




                                                                                                                                   3/5

For instance, I know that I will practice that gratitude meditation on the commute to
work, or in bed before I get up,, or (answer this right now and have it decided).

Use the same approach for each lesson. When you are listening to the lesson, imagine
when you will do it, and put that in your schedule.

This will make you more consistent, and consistent practice will build new neural
pathways, and that will prepare you for the next exercise.

How are the lessons structured?
There is a course into, which is a video.

The actual lesson is mp3 audio. Listen to these lesson audios multiple times. You will be
surprised how much new or different information you will hear each time you listen.

The people that get the best results listen multiple times.

Then there are some notes to help you focus on the exercise to practice.

And some written copy about the types of resistance and obstacles likely to show up.

What if I have resistance to doing the exercises?
If you have resistance, or excuses for not doing the exercise then you have a great
opportunity.

This is completely expected, and the exercises themselves are great to practice with on
these resistance aspects.

If you do nothing else in this program but address the resistance that shows up to these
exercises, you will have a massively successful change process.

One of the ways you will have criticism is by the critical voice in your head telling you
that you are doing a terrible job. This voice doesn’t know what it is talking about.

Listen to the podcast below on how this “pseudo score-keeper” gets it wrong.

Supporting videos


Watch Video At: https://youtu.be/RSo8SmJnLNs

Studies have documented the benefits of mindfulness, but what makes
up mindfulness?

The gap of several days between sessions is to give you time to practice. This is vital if
you are going to build new neural pathways. This is necessary so that you can create
different interpretations, change point of view, and change emotional responses.




                                                                                                                                   4/5

Pathway to Happiness

   pathwaytohappiness.com/courses/self-mastery-course-1/introduction

                                                                                       August 17, 2019




Introduction


Watch Video At: https://youtu.be/nSvQfPjqjw4

Some notes to help you focus

Before you can change a belief you will need some skills. Some of those skills will also
include awareness. Awareness,,, that’s difficult to explain. It’s not something the
intellect can grasp so you won’t be getting it by obtaining knowledge. It might be like a
musician listening to sounds of specific instruments, and how they harmonize, or cancel
each other.

What you are going to pay attention to are your thoughts, emotions, body posture,
perspective, attention, and personal power. If you can track those things you can
change them.

Often you won’t notice these things until after the fact when you are writing about them.
That is fine. You will learn lot by taking this reflective or reviewing perspective. It
trains your brain that these qualities are important. Then, with repetition you will
notice these elements in the moment. Then you will be able to change them in the
moment.

You are going to be able to make big changes in your life

This is going to start by learning how to make small changes. You will gain greater
control over your attention with each thing you practice. Don’t worry that the mountain
is big. Just keep taking steps.

Resistance to change

Some of the exercises will have resistance. You may not have resistance to some or any
of them. But if you do, we don’t want you to get knocked off your path. And if you do,
then we want you to learn from it, get more aware, stronger, and see how to stay on the
path next time those resistance elements show up.




                                                                                                                                   1/2

The resistance are will help identify some of the common culprits that are testing to see
how much you want this. In a way, they are challenging you and making you stronger
with the gravity they make you work against.

Common questions

How long will it take to change a belief?
Impossible to tell. Often the belief that people feel is the problem is just what their
intellect is focused on. Usually the real important belief with all the emotion is a layer or
two underneath that.

I’ve seen some that took 2 years. But this was a case of strong sexual abuse, a
schizophrenic mother and alcoholic father. She found acceptance of herself, forgave her
mom, and is no longer afraid of being around strangers.

In my own journey I didn’t find some for 2 years. But I didn’t have an organized system
like the Self Mastery course when I started.

I’ve also seen big beliefs change in an hour.

When those big beliefs have changed in an hour, it has always been because someone
put in a lot of preparation work and dismantled other beliefs to weaken them first.

A lot of it depends on how many years you have been packing your personal power into
the same concept. It also depends on how willing and open you are to change your
perspective.





                                                                                                                                   2/2
